sketches.mechanism: A recursive binding can be given a fully polymorphic type; laziness allows it to inhabit any type until evaluation, where it diverges.
sketches.resonance: Absence can take any shape, but the moment it is needed it gives nothing back.
sketches.draft:
absence :: a
absence = absence

touch :: ()
touch = absence

sketches.mechanism: A context manager suppresses an exception when its __exit__ method returns True.
sketches.resonance: What would have broken the world is acknowledged by the frame that contains it, then allowed to vanish.
sketches.draft:
class Mercy:
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, wound, memory, trace): return True

with Mercy():
    raise Exception()

sketches.mechanism: The __END__ token stops compilation; following text is treated as data and cannot execute as code.
sketches.resonance: After the end, even a command to fail becomes only a remnant, no longer able to happen.
